lead_raw_text:
The structure of CsMg14Bi crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 32-atom unit cell (Cs2Mg28Bi2) and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Bi and Cs centers each surrounded by 16 Mg neighbors, while Mg environments vary from 10- to 16-coordinate, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.05 to 3.43 Å. Polyhedron-sharing analysis of the 16-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
